static_traits.name: Mark
static_traits.social_status: has some close friends to confide in, but they may not fully understand the Work difficulties; relationships with colleagues affected and tense
static_traits.medical_history: No significant physical illness; no similar problems in the past; not yet received psychotherapy or counseling
static_traits.language_features: clear expression, fairly organized thinking, able to describe events and automatic thoughts specifically; highly cooperative,Positive attitude; emotions mainly anger and disappointment; speech rate Not mentioned

basic_info.main_problem: I feel my boss dislikes me and will never promote me, which makes me feel undervalued and career-stalled at Work.
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling because the feeling of being undervalued at work has affected my overall well-being and motivation.

special_situations.event: not yet receiving a promotion I believed I deserved six months ago
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: if I have not been promoted, it meansI am not good enough or my supervisor dislikes me
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Works harder, discusses with colleagues and applies for jobs at other coffee shops to seek recognition
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: my boss definitely dislikes me, he will never promote me

special_situations.event: last week completing a challenging project and delivering early, but the supervisor hardly showed approval and instead praised a colleague
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: if not directly praised, it means my Work is not good enough and I am not valued
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Using the supervisor's feedback as the main indicator of success, reducing engagement or turning to searching for a new job
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: he will not recognize my efforts

special_situations.event: each time Interacting with supervisor or seeing others promoted
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: if others are promoted and I am not, it proves I am not as good as them and my career will stall
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Discusses complaints with colleagues and applies for other jobs to avoid being judged
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am not as good as them, my career will not progress

special_situations.event: recalling experiences of not yet being promoted and not yet being recognized at Work
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: unless I am recognized every time, what I do is never good enough
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Takes others' approval as the main standard of success, ignoring other objective performance
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: No matter what I do, it is not good enough

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized and promoted, to receive the boss's affirmation
core_conflict.fear: fear of Being rejected, being belittled, worrying the career will stall forever
defense_goal: Reduces the feeling of hurt by distancing himself from the boss and lowering involvement
shifting attention to job hunting to ease the anxiety of rejection

object_relations.self_representation: an undervalued employee powerless to change the situation
object_relations.object_representation: an indifferent, picky supervisor who will never recognize oneself

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: when the supervisor is Silence or praises others without yet affirming oneself
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: understanding the other's Silence as rejection and hostility, believing 'he dislikes me and will never promote me' (transference: Projecting feelings of being ignored onto the authority figure)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: using absolutist words (e.g. 'forever' 'never'), agitated or firm tone, repeatedly emphasizing being disliked and unrecognized, negating other Interpretations and evidence.

manifestations: Feeling undervalued and stagnant at work
Work changing from enjoyment to burden

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'.
manifestations: Attributes 'being underestimated' and 'being disliked' to the supervisor's hostility
In counseling, explains one's situation through others' thoughts (such as 'he hates me')

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Uses the supervisor's evaluation as the main standard of success
harsh self-blame of 'I never do well enough' appearing

exception_events.target_problem: when not yet recognized or seeing others promoted, the client usually feels undervalued and angry, then Decreased drive,Work performance affected
exception_events.unique_outcome: last week, the client completed a challenging project ahead of schedule and stayed engaged, but had not yet received the supervisor's clear praise at the time
exception_events.reason: different approach: focusing on concrete tasks and completing on time; different context: the project had clear goals and deadlines, helping concentration

positive_force: Willing to seek counseling and cooperate with behavioral experiments
Has the ability and commitment to complete challenging tasks (finished a project ahead of schedule)
Has some social support (friends and colleagues to confide in)
negative_force: excessive mind-reading and jumping to conclusions, overgeneralization, mental filtering, negating the positive
Self-worth overly dependent on external approval (supervisors' evaluations)

target_behavior.behavior: intense anger and disappointment with negative automatic thoughts when Interacting with supervisor or seeing others promoted
antecedent: the supervisor not yet affirming the performance
target_behavior.core_reason: promotion-related events activating the core belief 'I am not valued/I am not good enough' and cognitive biases (mind-reading, negating the positive, overgeneralization)
target_behavior.function: Temporarily protects self-esteem through negative attribution and emotional venting, avoiding further setbacks
target_behavior.consequence: Decreased job satisfaction,Decreased motivation,Tense relationships with colleagues

target_behavior.behavior: Decreased work motivation and lower performance (losing engagement with Work)
antecedent: recalling experiences of not yet being promoted
Noticing the boss recognizes others more
target_behavior.core_reason: equating external recognition and promotion with self-worth, not yet being recognized triggering helplessness and avoidance
target_behavior.function: Escaping further failure and feelings of rejection, reducing emotional pain
target_behavior.consequence: Career development blocked, fruitless job hunting, overall Decline in sense of well-being

target_behavior.behavior: Uses others' evaluations as the main standard of success, ignoring objective data
antecedent: When measuring work success, mainly refers to whether the boss praises or gives extra duties
target_behavior.core_reason: External validation dependence and a 'black-and-white' evaluation framework
target_behavior.function: seeking external recognition to briefly ease uncertainty and anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: negating one's positive performance, persistent Self-deprecation and sense of stagnation
